domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
t is a real number and 0 <= t < 1
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n > 1 and every real number t with 0 <= t < 1: floor(n*t) equals n minus 1 if and only if t is at least (n minus 1) divided by n and strictly less than 1.

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer universally quantified parameter in the floor expression floor(n*t) and in the bound (n-1)/n

variables.name: t
variables.role: universally quantified variable inside floor(n*t) and in the interval condition

witness_dependencies: none (no existential quantifiers); both sides of the equivalence depend only on the universally quantified variables n and t

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with 0 <= t < 1, floor(n*t) = n-1 if and only if (n-1)/n <= t < 1.
